title: ARCH: per-edge fill0/fill1 planar shape representation
description: Architectural flag — decide before more systems calcify on the current model. ShapePath holds ONE fill per closed contour (engine/types.ts:179-185), but Flash shapes and SWF shape records attach fills to BOTH sides of each edge (fill0/fill1); docs/03 requires a planar-map boolean engine with byte-faithful merge outcomes. The current representation cannot express two fills sharing an edge — the result of any real merge-drawing cut — and SWF export of multi-contour shapes already ignores FillStyle1/winding (shapes.ts:161,186-188, leaks noted in 0047). Migrating later rewrites renderer, tween morpher, merge engine, FLA schema, and SWF encoder simultaneously; cost grows with every feature built on the single-fill model. Scope this story to: design the per-edge representation, migration plan, and a decision on when to land it (post-MVP is acceptable; undocumented drift is not). See docs/03-drawing-vector-graphics.md.
